name: Octafoil Mirror with Paired Phoenixes, Birds, and Flowers
dimensions: Diameter: 28.8 cm (11 5/16 in.); Overall: 1.6 cm (5/8 in.); Rim: 1 cm (3/8 in.)
summary: Octafoil Mirror with Paired Phoenixes, Birds, and Flowers (雙鳳花鳥菱花鏡), late 700s. China, Tang dynasty (618-907). Bronze; diameter: 28.8 cm (11 5/16 in.); overall: 1.6 cm (5/8 in.); rim: 1 cm (3/8 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of Drs. Thomas and Martha Carter in Honor of Sherman E. Lee, 1995.
